title: Free Realms Trading Card Game: Rumbledome!
names_seen: Free Realms Trading Card Game: Rumbledome!

facts.statement: Rumbledome! is the fifth Free Realms Trading Card Game release, set in Sunstone Valley, and its virtual rewards are randomly packed in booster packs.
facts.quote: The fifth release for the Free Realms Trading Card Game is almost upon us!

article_summaries.title: First Look: TCG Set 5 Rumbledome! Loot
article_summaries.summary: Executive Producer Mark Tuttle previews the virtual rewards (rides, housing, clothing, hats, a pet, building materials and a questline reward) found in booster packs for the fifth Free Realms Trading Card Game set, Rumbledome!, set in Sunstone Valley. The page is undated; it says 'Posted 2 days, 13 hours ago' relative to the 2013-03-18 capture, so the post is from about mid-March 2013 and describes an upcoming release ('Coming soon!').
